invitationLines: We would like for you to join us

attire.subtitle: Dress Code
attire.title: Romantic Sunset Garden
attire.intro: We shared some of our most precious moments in the warm embrace of sunsets. We would love for you to dress in the warm colors we fell in love in.

features.title: Dressy Garden Casual
features.description: Strike a balance between polish and relaxed with long dresses, flowing fabrics, soft and elegant silhouettes.

features.title: Wear sunset colors
features.description: Channel the golden hour glow with warm and vibrant colors, or slip into the comfortable elegance of floral motifs.

schedule.title: Cocktails & Ceremony
schedule.description: Be welcomed with refreshments and booth activities followed by an intimate exchange of vows in the garden.

schedule.title: Dinner & Program
schedule.description: Settle down and enjoy dinner, & games at the Hall.

search.title: Find Your Invitation
search.intro: Enter your name as it appears on your invitation to find your party.
search.notFoundMessage: Please double-check the spelling, or reach out to the couple directly and we'll sort it out.

party.emailHint: We'll only use this to send wedding updates, if you'd like them.
party.songIntro: Got any song suggestions for the dancefloor?

thankYou.title: Thank You
thankYou.attendingMessage: We can't wait to celebrate with you. See you on the dance floor!
thankYou.decliningMessage: You'll be missed, but we appreciate you letting us know.

questions.question: Can I cancel my RSVP?
questions.answer: Yes, but please inform us right away so we can fill up the seats.

questions.question: Are children welcome?
questions.answer: The celebration will be adults-only with a few kids invited from our immediate families. We thank you for understanding.

questions.question: What time should I arrive?
questions.answer: The program will start 4:00PM so please arrive a little early to get settled and enjoy the ceremony.

questions.question: Can I bring a plus one?
questions.answer: We want to keep our wedding intimate so only guests formally invited will be accommodated.

questions.question: Is there parking available?
questions.answer: The venue has provisions for 50 parking slots.

questions.question: Where can i stay?
questions.answer: The Citywalk Suites is right next to the venue.

questions.question: Regarding gifts?
questions.answer: Your presence at the wedding is the greatest gift of all. Should you wish to give a gift, a monetary contribution towards our future together would be appreciated.
